description: Send the answers of a new account's onboarding form (whoami gives onboarding_required and the questions). Ask the user the questions and use the answers that the user gives. Show the user all answers and get a yes. Product files are optional: send the text only of files that the user gives you for this form. Sell to State saves the profile, reads the website and the files, and builds the user's first search with a weekly email alert. Returns {status, summary, counts, rows (each with url), app_url, saved_search, next_options}; status generating: call get_onboarding_search with build_id.

company_name.description: Only when the questions ask for it (free-mail address).

company_website.description: The company website, for example acme.com.

confirmed.description: True after the user said yes to the answers.

countries.description: Country names, slugs or ISO alpha-2 codes, for example ["Kenya", "ZA"].

documents.description: Optional. Product files that the user gave you for this form (spec sheet, catalogue, capability statement), as their text. 40,000 characters in total at most.

intent.description: What the user wants to do.

intent_other.description: The user's own words, when intent is other.

job_title.description: Only when the questions ask for it (free-mail address).

name.description: Only when the questions ask for it.

sells.description: What the company sells, in one line.

works_independently.description: True when the user has no company website.

name: submit_onboarding
title: Send the onboarding answers
